title: Stochastic Finite-Transition Learning and Exploration for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
title_zh: 用于加速MRI重建的随机有限跃迁学习与探索

paragraphs.en: 用于加速MRI重建的FLEX-MRI方法通过学习有限区间内的恢复变化，结合随机探索提升了重建性能。 Generative MRI reconstruction maps an initial source distribution to the target image distribution along a learned recovery trajectory. Common generative methods, such as diffusion and flow, typically learn fine-grained local dynamics whose integration defines this global mapping, hence requiring many network evaluations at inference. Existing few-step sampling approaches can lower computational burden by approximating large transformations from local dynamics, albeit at the expense of reconstruction fidelity. FLEX-MRI instead partitions recovery into a small number of finite intervals between retained states defined by progressive changes in k-space support, and directly learns the reconstruction change across each interval. Because such finite transitions can admit multiple plausible outcomes, FLEX-MRI combines support-relaxed finite-transition learning with stochastic exploration. During training, randomized k-space sampling masks define finite-transition targets with varying support, while the prediction loss remains unrestricted by each individual mask. At inference, FLEX-MRI perturbs a random subset of currently estimated k-space coefficients, allowing the learned predictor to stochastically explore alternative transition paths. Each predicted state is then reconciled with the acquired measurements through data consistency. We theoretically show that this stochastic exploration induces nonzero transition-level variation through the learned recovery map and data consistency without requiring an auxiliary generative sampler. Experiments on multi-coil MRI datasets show that FLEX-MRI outperforms competing methods while maintaining computational efficiency comparable to few-step baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 用于加速MRI重建的FLEX-MRI方法通过学习有限区间内的恢复变化，结合随机探索提升了重建性能。生成式MRI重建将初始源分布沿一条已学习的恢复轨迹映射到目标图像分布。 常见的生成式方法（如扩散和流方法）通常学习精细的局部动态，其积分定义了这种全局映射，因此需要在推理阶段进行多次网络评估。 现有的少步采样方法可以通过用局部动态近似较大的变换来降低计算负担，但会牺牲重建保真度。 相比之下，FLEX-MRI将恢复过程划分为少数几个有限区间，这些区间由k空间支持中渐进变化所定义的保留状态之间的边界确定，并直接学习每个区间内的重建变化。 由于这类有限转换可能产生多种合理的结果，FLEX-MRI将支持松弛的有限转换学习与随机探索相结合。 在训练阶段，随机化的k空间采样掩码定义了具有不同支持的有限转换目标，而预测损失不受单个掩码的限制。 在推理阶段，FLEX-MRI会扰动当前估计的k空间系数中的一个随机子集，使已学习的预测器能够随机探索替代的转换路径。 随后，每个预测状态会通过数据一致性准则与采集到的测量数据进行匹配。 我们从理论上证明，这种随机探索无需辅助生成采样器，就能通过已学习的恢复映射和数据一致性在转换层面引入非零变化。 在多线圈MRI数据集上的实验表明，FLEX-MRI在保持与少步基线方法相当的计算效率的同时，性能优于其他竞争方法。
